571e243d-dd9c-41a8-8d3e-9034adcce68f/Eve.en: "To insult my ancestor is a crime punishable by death!"<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> tried to explain, but before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> could finish,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> saw <Character key=ActorId str=Name/> with angry eyes, full of killing intent, shouting furiously.<NL>He charged toward the two of them, and in a flash, <Character key=ActorId str=Name/> was right in front of them!
571e243d-dd9c-41a8-8d3e-9034adcce68f/Eve.cn: “辱我先祖，死不足惜！”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>急急出言解释，谁知话音未落，<NL>便见<Character key=ActorId str=Name/>横眉立目，杀气腾腾，疾声怒骂，<NL>气势汹汹地向二人杀来，不过转眼之间，<Character key=ActorId str=Name/>便已袭至眼前！

4921a6cc-1ac6-46a4-969e-d362a9b0f721/Eve.en: The security for the "secret unique art" competition is tight.<NL>Since I've never seen anything like this before, and since I'm already here, why not check it out myself?<NL>With that thought, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> asked the Lion-Face Clan disciple to pose a question...
4921a6cc-1ac6-46a4-969e-d362a9b0f721/Eve.cn: “秘密绝艺”比试守卫森严，<NL>其间情景<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>向来未有所闻，自己既已到此，又何妨亲自一探？<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>想到此处，当即出言请狮相门弟子出题……
4921a6cc-1ac6-46a4-969e-d362a9b0f721/Eve.ru: Условия проведения конкурса "Секретное Уникальное искусство" очень строгие.<NL>Поскольку я никогда раньше не видел ничего подобного, и поскольку я уже здесь, почему бы не проверить это самому?<NL>С этой мыслью, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> попросил ученика клана Львинолицых задать вопрос...

4921a6cc-1ac6-46a4-969e-d362a9b0f721/Opt.en: I'm willing to try! Please ask the question...
4921a6cc-1ac6-46a4-969e-d362a9b0f721/Opt.cn: 我愿一试！还请阁下出题……
4921a6cc-1ac6-46a4-969e-d362a9b0f721/Opt.ru: Я готов попробовать! Пожалуйста, задайте этот вопрос...

2ebccccc-b7ae-41d3-9499-be3b049768b1/Eve.en: "Your courage to face difficulties is truly admirable, a true hero!"<NL><NL>The Lion-Face Clan disciple praised <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s bravery with a bow.<NL>However, his words were a jumble of mismatched idioms, leaving <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> utterly confused.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> could only force a smile and say nothing more...
2ebccccc-b7ae-41d3-9499-be3b049768b1/Eve.cn: “阁下迎难而上，果真是顶天立地，壮志凌云，一勇之夫！”<NL><NL>狮相门弟子闻言，拱手大赞<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>勇气可嘉，<NL>只是其所言之词可谓驴唇马嘴，听得<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>云里雾里，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>只得尴尬一笑，并不多言……

e5d074f9-1210-45c6-8c2e-fcbce656a43b/Eve.en: The scholar looked ashamed and replied in a low voice:<NL>"The members of the Lion-Face Clan are all heroes, unconcerned with trifles.<NL>Although there are rumors in the market about the ignorance of the Lion-Face Clan, any discerning person knows they are absurd.<NL>Why does the Sect Leader take it so seriously and resort to 'violence'?"
e5d074f9-1210-45c6-8c2e-fcbce656a43b/Eve.cn: 文人面露惭愧之色，压低声音悄声回道：<NL>“狮相门的诸位都是英雄豪杰，不拘小节，<NL>市井虽传闻狮相门种种无知，明眼人又有哪个不知是荒唐胡言，<NL>门主何须如此介怀，大动‘干戈’？”

e5d074f9-1210-45c6-8c2e-fcbce656a43b/Opt.en: (So it's because of the rumors in the market?)
